channel.title: The Grant Desk - Fellowships, Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact, US, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Fellowships, Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact, US, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant plus a short roundup header, instead of trickling out daily.

item.title: 1 new Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact fellowship - week of 20 Jul 2026
item.description:
• Nebraska Arts Council: Individual Artist Fellowship 2026 (Performing Arts)
    https://www.artscouncil.nebraska.gov/apply/individual-artist-fellowship/
    Nebraska Arts Council · deadline 17 Nov 2026 · Up to $5,000 for a one-year fellowship supporting professional development, including the creation of new art, presentations, training and/or research. No application fee.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).
